snippet.title: Hardcore Circus - Gameplay and Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the Free Demo on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3493450/Hardcore_Circus_Demo/

Hardcore Circus is a difficult precision-platformer where you play as Dik, a skilled acrobat on a daring quest to rescue his brother from the grasp of the Devil.

Face unique traversal and lethal obstacles like Rotating Gear, Portals, Saws, Cannons, Levers, Spikes, Trampolines, Air and Water Currents, Gargoyles, Sharks, Whales, Elephants and many more.

Addictive gameplay, get up and try again until you perfect it!

Contact: contact@pocketsofenergy.com
